The derivation correctly identifies that a discrete eigenvalue appears exactly when the discriminant \((d-1)(d-9)\) becomes non‑negative, i.e. for \(d\ge 9\). For \(d\le 8\) the spectrum consists only of the continuous part, so the averaging process mixes at the same rate as the simple random walk and exhibits an \(L^2\) cutoff. Hence the critical degree separating the two regimes is indeed \(d_c=8\).
